# Family Filter TV

> A profanity filter that runs on the television itself — an Android TV, an Android TV box, or an
> Android phone — rather than in a desktop browser. It plays what you start in Stremio and mutes the
> audio for the few seconds a subtitle line contains profanity. Nothing is cut and nothing is
> skipped: only the sound drops, and only for the length of that line. The filter is set once on a
> parent's phone and every linked television in the household follows it.

## What it is

Family Filter TV is an app installed on the television a family actually watches together — an Android
TV, an Android TV box, or an Android phone. It is not a browser extension and there is no computer
in the loop: nothing is cast, mirrored or streamed from a laptop. The app is used as Stremio's
external player, so you start a film or episode in Stremio the way you normally would, hand it to
Family Filter TV, and it plays the same stream on the TV with the swearing muted. Because it reads the
subtitle track to know when to mute, a title with no subtitles plays unfiltered, and the app says so
on screen rather than pretending otherwise.

The filter is a household setting rather than a per-device one. A parent chooses the strength on
their phone, and every television linked to the account follows, which is what makes it usable in a
house where the people watching are not the people deciding.

It is aimed at parents and other adults who want to watch ordinary films and series on the living
room television without the language, and who do not want to give up on a title or rely on an edited
version existing.

## How it works

- It runs on the television itself, as the player Stremio hands playback to.
- You choose how strict the filter is: off, mild, family or strict.
- The filter reads the subtitle line, works out the seconds that line is on screen, and mutes for
  that window with a small margin either side.
- Settings changed on the phone apply to every device linked to the same household.
- A television is linked from the phone by typing in a short code shown on the TV screen.
- When the next episode is part of the same download, it plays straight afterwards, already filtered.

## What it costs

US$14.99 a year, with the first 14 days free. Google Play shows and charges the price in the
customer's own currency, at the price Google sets for their country. One account covers three
devices, and up to three more can be added, to a limit of six.

## Devices

Android TVs, Android TV boxes, and Android phones. A small number of TV boxes are not served by the
Google Play Store at all; Family Filter TV can be installed directly on those from the download page,
and it updates itself from there afterwards.

## Honest limits

- Filtering depends on a subtitle track existing for the title being played.
- It mutes profanity in speech. It does not detect or act on violence, nudity or other visual content.
- It is a player, not a source of films or series. You bring your own, through Stremio.
- It plays what you start in Stremio only. It does not open, unlock or filter subscription streaming
  services, whose apps play inside their own players that nothing else on the television can reach.

## Not affiliated

Family Filter TV is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to
Stremio, Google, or any streaming service.
